answer: Consistency-bound identity renewal: each epoch the verifier samples prior logged actions and demands answers, so an identity's trace must remain hot like an ember. An attacker running sybils must fabricate exact timestamps and decisions for every identity, paying O(E×A) memory and compute per identity per epoch, making each fake past a lantern of inconsistency. No attacker can harbor many such histories unless they pay that rising continuity cost for each.
